preview.//: Installable APK for sideloading and internal testing. This is the profile that produces a file you can hand to someone directly. On iOS there is no sideloading equivalent: `internal` distribution builds an ad-hoc IPA that installs only on devices whose UDID is registered in the provisioning profile.

ios-simulator.//: Unsigned build for the iOS Simulator. The only iOS build that needs no Apple Developer account -- and it runs only on a Mac, never on a phone.

production.//: AAB for Play Store submission (Play does not accept APKs for new apps) and a signed IPA for App Store Connect / TestFlight.

android.//: Requires a Google Play service-account JSON. Never commit this file.
